title: Chapter 3 — The Core
description: The final chapter. A hundred and one rooms from the pour to the core, and a new tool to get through them: the extendable hand. It takes hold of what is marked — bars pull you up, everything else pulls toward you. Wall signs are gone from all three chapters, the sound has been rebuilt from scratch, and the menu is no longer a menu.
changelog: Chapter 3 — The Core: 101 rooms, two subfloors, and the end of it
The extendable hand: pull yourself to bars, haul shutters down, tear jammed doors apart, drag crates across a floor
The archive: index it in three waves while the Playerr hunts you across the stacks
Two hunts, a duct run, a riser climb and a fight against both of them at once
The ignition gallery: arm four emitters and light a core with them
Every wall sign removed from Chapters 1, 2 and 3 — claw marks and drag trails instead
Sound rebuilt: a heartbeat that tracks your fear, breathing, and a scream that is not a sample
New menu: a corridor that recedes into the dark, and something at the end of it that looks back
A real ending for Chapter 2 — the pour, seen through the window, all the way down
Fixed: the objective ribbon showed Chapter 1's objectives for the whole of Chapter 2
notes: A signed release build, not a debug one. Installs over any earlier build and keeps every world; every release is signed with the same key so updates never need an uninstall.
